product_overview: A backend service that interprets natural-language user commands and routes them to the correct government-service skill. It also supports OCR-based document text extraction and resume generation workflows.
core_goals: Detect user intent from informal or multilingual commands and route to the appropriate skill
Extract text from uploaded document images using OCR
Generate professional PDF resumes from user-provided data
Provide simple API-driven workflows for command processing and document services

features.name: Master Agent Command Routing
features.description: Natural-language command processing that identifies the requested government-service task and returns the matched skill.
user_flows: POST /api/command with valid userId and cmd for "सर मुझे एसएससी का फॉर्म भरना है" -> Receive 200 with matched skill "form_fill" and message confirming routing
POST /api/command with valid userId and cmd for "mujhe ek shayari sunao acchi wali" -> Receive 200 with matched skill "notepad" and message confirming routing
POST /api/command with empty cmd or unsupported text -> Receive error response indicating the command could not be understood or no skill matched

features.name: Document OCR Processing
features.description: OCR processing for uploaded document images to extract readable text from photos or scans such as PAN cards or ID documents.
user_flows: POST /api/ocr/process with a valid authenticated request and an uploaded image file containing document text -> Receive 200 with extracted text/object payload
POST /api/ocr/process with a valid token but a corrupt, unreadable, or missing image file -> Receive error response indicating OCR processing failed or input is invalid

features.name: Resume Generation
features.description: Creates a professional PDF resume from structured user details for job applications and similar needs.
user_flows: Provide resume input data to the resume generation workflow -> System generates a PDF resume using @react-pdf/renderer and returns the downloadable document
Provide incomplete or invalid resume data -> System returns an error indicating required fields are missing or the resume could not be generated
